claim_summary: EvoCast contributes a feedback-driven autonomous research loop that grounds forecasting architecture changes in executed diagnostics and prior outcomes while separating LLM generation from deterministic evaluation and promotion.

claim_evidence.quote: This paper presents EvoCast, a fully autonomous research-agent system for task-specific forecasting architecture evolution.

state updates. Successful improvements, scientific negative results, and engineering failures are written into the evidence state, reducing repeated trial-and-error and grounding later rounds in auditable facts.

modules.name: Cognition-authority separated execution loop
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK is no: source boundaries and role permissions manage execution without a forecasting objective; R3_2_GTS is no because this layer has no temporal semantics; R3_3_GH is yes.

evidence.quote: Program authorities control source boundary checking, candidate materialization, canonical evaluation, promotion gate decisions, result semantics, and persistent state update.
This separation defines three permissions. LLM agents can generate research intent and code changes. Builder edits must remain inside the fixed editable boundary.

modules.name: Canonical evaluation and promotion gate
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK is yes: canonical forecasting metrics, comparison and multi-seed promotion define the accepted result; changing task family changes the objective metric and admissibility gate.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - embeds forecasting metric and promotion criterion

evidence.quote: Candidate source code first passes source compliance and artifact construction, then runs through the fixed evaluator to generate canonical metrics, and finally enters the Promotion Gate.

Model-state promotion is triggered only when the candidate passes boundary validation, produces valid canonical metrics, and satisfies the fixed multi-seed comparison rule against the current incumbent.

modules.name: Outcome-typed research evidence and failure memory
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK is no: the state store records generic round outcomes; R3_2_GTS is no because it does not depend on temporal semantics; R3_3_GH is yes, with feedback updating runtime state across rounds.

evidence.quote: The next Research Planner reads the full updated research state, including accepted candidates, negative results, unstable improvements, repair history, failure memory, and baseline diagnosis.
evidence state accumulates valid improvements, negatives, unstable gains, and failure records, allowing subsequent planning to use the full research trajectory.

modules.name: Forecasting task protocol grounding
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK is yes: the procedure freezes forecasting target, windows, mode and metric as the task contract; changing task family changes those requirements. Dataset characterization performs temporal-series processing.

evidence.quote: Before research begins, the system fixes the dataset, target, lookback, horizon, forecasting mode, metric, training budget, research-round budget, and repair budget.
Task grounding also converts the raw dataset into planner-readable evidence.

modules.name: Executed baseline mechanism diagnosis
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK is yes: active forecasting mechanisms are ablated and judged by the forecasting protocol; changing task family changes the objective and diagnostic criterion.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - ablation judgment embeds forecasting objective

evidence.quote: The selected baseline identifies which executable model is currently strongest, and baseline diagnosis identifies why that model works on the current task.

EvoCast analyzes the active prediction path of 𝑏 ★, extracts ablatable mechanisms, and turns them into executable diagnosis targets tied to concrete source regions and input-output preservation contracts.

process_validity.quote: Table 1: Overall method-level RQ1 results. Success is the proportion of tasks that pass the canonical validation pipeline; Fidelity is the proportion of evaluated implementations that realize the given idea without semantic mismatch; Repair is computed only over repair-eligible tasks.

temporal_validity.quote: All tasks follow the same experimental protocol: the data are split by chronological order with a 7:1:2 ratio for training, validation, and testing; no split is shuffled;

task_performance.quote: Table 3 reports the final formal forecasting results on the three real cases. EvoCast reduces the selected-baseline error on all three tasks.

items.result: GH, Planning and Orchestration + Tools and Execution, inferred reuse
items.reason: Separation of LLM cognitive roles from program authorities (source-boundary checking, builder edits inside a fixed boundary, agent self-report not becoming a conclusion) has no temporal semantics or forecasting objective.
Promotion requires valid canonical metrics and a fixed multi-seed comparison against the incumbent, a forecasting-evaluation criterion that must be redesigned for another task family (R3_1 yes).
